description: This Java class defines a Liquibase change for modifying an existing database column. It provides properties to specify schema, table, and column details, and generates the SQL statement to apply the modification.

classes.name: ModifyColumnChange
classes.description: A class representing a change to modify an existing database column within a Liquibase migration.

methods.name: getCatalogName
methods.description: Returns the catalog name where the table resides, if specified.

methods.name: setCatalogName
methods.description: Sets the catalog name where the table resides.

methods.name: getSchemaName
methods.description: Returns the schema name for the target table.

methods.name: setSchemaName
methods.description: Sets the schema name for the target table.

methods.name: getTableName
methods.description: Returns the name of the table containing the column to modify.

methods.name: setTableName
methods.description: Sets the name of the table containing the column to modify.

methods.name: getColumns
methods.description: Returns the list of column configurations to modify.

methods.name: setColumns
methods.description: Sets the list of column configurations to modify.

methods.name: addColumn
methods.description: Adds a column configuration to the list of columns to be modified.

methods.name: removeColumn
methods.description: Removes a column configuration from the list.

methods.name: generateStatements
methods.description: Generates the SQL statement(s) necessary to modify the column(s) in the database.

methods.name: getConfirmationMessage
methods.description: Provides a message summarizing the modification action performed.
